chapter.verse: Suahtakna thu ah Khris in eite hong suaktasak khinta hi. Tua hangin kiptak om unla sila suahna hakkol nuai-ah niamlutkik kei un.
En un! Keimah Paul in kong genin ah vun-atna na kiphal uhleh no' adingin Khris a phattuamna om lo ding hi.
Vun-atna a kiphalte khempeuh' tungah teci kong pankikin ah tua bang mipa in thukhun a bupin zuih ding vaipuak a nei ahi hi.
Note, thukhun zuihna tawh diksakna ngah a sawmte, Khris tawh a kikhenkak na hi uh a, hehpihna na mansuah khin uh hi.
A hang pen kote mahmah in upna tawh diktatna ngah ding cih lamenin Kha tungtawnin lawptak ka ngak uh hi.
A hang pen Khris Jesu' sungah vun-atna ahi-a vun-atlohna ahi zongin a thupi bangmah om lo a, itna tawh a gamtang upna bek a thupi ahi hi.
Nidangin note ginatak na hanciam uh hi. Thumaan thutak na zuih loh nadingun kua in hong khaktan ahi hiam?
Hih zolkhiatna pen note hong sampa' kiangpan hilo hi.
Silngo themno khat in annel a lompi bup pawmsak hi.
Note in ngaihsut dang nei kei nuteh ci-in Topa' sungah ka lungmuang a, note hong nawngkaisakpa pen kuakua ahi zongin gawtna tuak ding hi.

Ahi zongin sanggamte aw, vun-atna thu mah hong tangko lai ka hihleh bang hangin tu ciangdong bawlsiat tuak laizang ding ka hi hiam? A tuaci hi le-ing singlamteh hanga puktheihna zong beisiang khin ding hi.
No hong lungbuaisakte in a pasalvan uh zong atkhiatawm vet uh hen!
A hang pen sanggamte aw, note pen suahtakna a ngah dinga hong kisamkhia ahi hi. Na suahtakna uh cilesa noptat theih nading paulap khatin zang kei unla itna tawh khatlekhat nasep na kihuhzaw un.
A hang pen thukhun buppi zong, “Na vengte nangmahmah bangin na it ding hi,” cih thu khat tawh a kicing ahi hi.
Himah taleh note khatlekhat kiphuai kipetin na om uhleh khatlekhat a kisusia na hihkhak ding uh kidawm un.
Kong thupiak ah, Kha tawh kalsuan un. Tua hileh cilesa deihnate zui lo-in na om ding uh hi.
A hang pen cilesa deihnate Kha tawh kilehngat a, Kha deihnate cilesa tawh kilehngat uh hi. Na sepnopte na sep theihloh nadingun hihte khatlekhat kilangpang uh hi.
Ahih hangin Kha in hong makaih leh note pen thukhun nuai-ah na om kei uh hi.
Tu-in cilesa nasepnate muhtheih hi a, nulepa tatkhialhna, thanghuai gamtatna, cilesa paktatna,
milim biakna, aitawina, kigalneihna, kitotna, kidemnopna, hehsuahna, angsung khualna hanga kiselna, lungsim kikakna, pawltuam neihna,
hazatna, zukham sakhamna, gualnop gamlumna leh tua dan namte ahi hi. Hih banga gamtate Pasian' kumpigam luahkha lo ding ci-in kong genkholhsa mah bangin tu-in zong kong genkhol hi.
Ahih hangin Kha thupha gah ahihleh itna, nuamna, nopna lemna, lungduaina, migitna, lungsim hoihna, cihtakna,
lungnemna, pumpi ki-ukzawhna, cihte ahi hi. Hihte tawh a kilehngat thukhun cih bang om lo hi.
Tua hi a, Khris Jesu' pawl ahite in cilesa leh a sunga om duhna deihna khempeuh singlamteh tungah khailum khin uh hi.
Kha hangin a nungta i hihleh Kha tawh kituakin gamta ni.
Kiphatsakna tawh khatlekhat kiphin, khatlekhat ki-eng cih bang hikei ni.
